t: This is Sion Hall, a building in London that formerly housed Sion College. It was designed by Arthur Blomfield, a prolific English architect and keen church builder. He became president of the Architectural Association in 1861, was architect to the Bank of England, and was knighted. In 1891 he received the RIBA gold medal. Arthur Murray Dale, an Anglican priest who later became a Catholic convert, was born here in 1850.
